name: Bupa Arabia for Cooperative Insurance Company
method: Text layer + stmt_pages.py + rendering of the two image-page files. Cross-foots: A=L+E, CF end cash = BS cash, Q1+Q2 = 6M.

dimension_1_value_correctness.summary: Extractable and verified: FY2025 (with FY2024), Q1 2026, H1 2026 in full; FY2024/FY2023/FY2022 headline from BS and income pages; 9M 2023 and Q1 2024 income statements from images. Not read: equity statements, notes, insurance-segment/shareholder-operation notes, all other interims beyond comparatives.
dimension_1_value_correctness.units: Saudi Riyals THOUSANDS (stated on every statement); EPS in SAR per share. From FY2023 filings the income statement is IFRS 17 (insurance revenue / insurance service result); gross written premiums are not on the face of the P&L. 2022 and earlier interims/annual are IFRS 4 (net premiums written/earned, insurance + shareholders operations) and are not comparable line-by-line.

transcriptions.pdf_pages: BS p8 and income p9 (FY2022-24 files; FY2023 p10-11 because of a longer BS)

dimension_1_value_correctness.restatements: IFRS 17/9 adoption (1 Jan 2023): FY2022 comparatives restated in the FY2023 file - total assets 14,310,442 -> 12,114,931, equity 4,293,879 -> 4,200,889, shareholders income before zakat 1,026,881 -> 969,163, EPS 5.78 -> 5.39; Q1 2022 also restated (Q1 2023 file) and 9M 2022 (restated 9M net income 658,874). Any series must use the restated IFRS 17 basis from 1 Jan 2022 and not mix with the original FY2022/2022 interim files.

dimension_2_document_completeness.summary: All 18 files are Bupa Arabia statement sets with all primary statements: 16 text-layer, 2 (9M 2023, Q1 2024) with image-only statement pages that the inventory called partial. Entity matches in all cover pages. No wrong-company, duplicate or non-statement file.

defects.what: FY files labelled with the publication year: 2023|FY=FY2022, 2024|FY=FY2023, 2025|FY=FY2024, 2026|FY=FY2025. Inventory marks 2022|FY absent although FY2022 is present.
95642519 (9M 2023) and a4bc7633 (Q1 2024) were counted partial_statements; their income, OCI, equity and cash-flow pages are image-only (BS of Q1 2024 has text) - complete when rendered.
period_mismatch_candidate on the four FY files comes from the label vs cover year (cover is correct for the true FY; label wrong). Interims: labels match covers.
Reporting basis changes in 2023 (IFRS 4 -> IFRS 17, insurance revenue instead of premiums). Not a document defect but a comparability constraint for any extraction.

dimension_3_company_coverage.inventory_claim: sparse; first observed 2008|FY; 54 absent periods; 2022|FY absent; 2023|9M and 2024|Q1 partial
dimension_3_company_coverage.corrected_from_pages: Every period from Q1 2022 to H1 2026 (18 interim) and FY2022-FY2025 (4 annual) is present with a complete statement set (including the two image-page files). Absent: FY2021 and everything before (the raw archive starts at Q1 2022 although the company is listed since 2008); 2026 FY not expected. Q4 periods must be derived. FY2021 original (IFRS 4) figures are available only as comparatives in the FY2022 and Q1-Q3 2022 files.

unread_items: Equity statements and all notes (segment, shareholders vs insurance operations split)
Values of Q2/Q3/H1/9M 2022-2025 sets other than those listed (presence and period confirmed only)
FY2023/FY2022 files read at headline level only
